# Discrete models vs. networks: scoreboard (generated by judge_models.py)

Reference: muP MLP trained with Adam, fixed training set (3 seeds). n* = training-set size at which the seed-mean test error reaches 0.1 ('never' counted as 2 x 16384 for the ratio statistics). Per-example agreement: excess agreement with the network over independent errors, as a fraction of the maximum (same training set), on cells where the network is partially right. Time Spearman: network steps-to-generalise vs the model's own clock, over cells where both generalise. Models were calibrated on CALIB functions only.
